question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 4)***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Occured"** is misspelled. The correct spelling is **"Occurred".** (घटित हुआ)

 
 
• **Example: **A significant event occurred yesterday that changed the course of history.
 
 
 
• **"Occurred" **means to ***happen or take plac***e. (घटित हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **An accident ***occurred ***on the highway last night.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is '***Occurred'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Equally** (समान रूप से): To the same degree or level.

 
 
• **Example:** The prize was*** equally*** shared among the winners.
 
 
 
• **Unwilling** (अनिच्छुक): Not ready, eager, or prepared to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was ***unwilling*** to participate in the event.
 
 
 
• **Argument** (तर्क): An exchange of diverging or opposite views.
 
 
• **Example:** They had an*** argument ***about the best way to solve the problem.
